t: You're on Palace Gardens Terrace, a street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It's known here as the birthplace of Jim Rose, born in 1909. Eliot Joseph Benn Rose, known as Jim, became a British intelligence officer, a journalist and a campaigner. He lived until 1999. The material about this street is thin, so that's the story of the place: a residential address that gave London a man with three careers.
